initiatives.name: Out Now Youth
initiatives.description: The only queer youth organization in Springfield MA, Out Now provides a safe space for queer youth & allies who are 22 yrs and under to learn about themselves, develop lasting friendships and leadership skills, explore LGBTQ+ history, and so much more.

initiatives.name: ARISE for Social Justice
initiatives.description: Member-led group of low-income people in Springfield, Massachusetts, organizing since 1985 on welfare rights, housing, criminal justice, and environmental justice.
